verdict.rationale: Pipedrive ships a first-party MCP server that lets users find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities and automate workflows from an AI assistant, which amounts to natural-language operation of the CRM. However, this works through an external assistant, and the only other support is a vague marketing line about managing deals with AI. Missing for 10: a documented in-product natural-language command interface, detail on which operations are supported by natural language and how reliably, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
